column1: # p292 — 2026-10-18 — OpenEduCat's grant, READ FIRST-HAND AT THE PIN.
# Method: p291's.  `git ls-remote <repo> master` for the SHA, then read the payload at that
# SHA on raw.githubusercontent.com — never at HEAD, never at a branch name.
# 🔴 The default branch is `master`, NOT `main`: /main/LICENSE answers 404 and that 404 is
# evidence about the branch name, not about the grant.
# Family assigned by compose/code/lib/license_family.sh (P237, the shared classifier) over the
# payload's TITLE BLOCK — not by eye and not by a body grep (P171).

column9: First line of the payload is "For copyright information, please see the COPYRIGHT file."; title block carries GNU LESSER GENERAL PUBLIC LICENSE / Version 3, 29 June 2007. family_of() returns LGPL-3.0.
/main/ answers 404 because the default branch is `master`. Recorded so the 404 is never re-read as an absent grant.

Separate proprietary licence restricting use to a valid OpenEduCat Enterprise Agreement and forbidding publishing, distributing, sublicensing or selling copies. 🔴 A WEB PAGE, not a committed payload — the boundary itself remains unread-as-a-file and is the residual gap.
Stated as unread rather than assumed. Its own community/enterprise split is a separate grant.
